chunks: The expiation for laughter is to say: 'O Allah, do not despise me.'

key_terms.اَللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct form of supplication to God
key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: expiation or atonement for an act
key_terms.لَا تَمْقُتْنِي: do not despise or detest me

ai.seo_question: What should one say as the expiation for laughter according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches a brief du'a to be said as expiation for laughter. It links ordinary behavior with spiritual awareness and directs the believer to seek Allah’s mercy and acceptance.
